capabilities: Copy a Fold space's notes into the vault's inbox/ and managed/ folders
Check for changes on an interval or via a Sync notes now command
Send edits and new inbox notes back to Fold when sending is enabled
Keep refused or conflicting edits as separate local-edit files
Connect a vault to a space using a Fold address and personal access token
disambiguation: Not an AI or memory plugin; it only keeps a vault in sync with a Fold memory space.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.4+; mobile is untested. README warns to disable script-running plugins like Dataview and Templater in vaults holding untrusted shared spaces, and notes releases are build-attested on GitHub.
problem: Notes that agents write in a Fold memory space cannot be read, searched or browsed with Obsidian's graph, backlinks and search from inside a vault.

relations.evidence: If another sync tool, such as Obsidian Sync, brings changes into the vault, they count as your edits

requires.name: 1p account with access to a Fold memory space
Fold personal access token (fold:read to copy, fold:write to send edits)

summary: Two-way sync plugin that copies a Fold memory space's notes into a vault and can send your edits and new inbox notes back to Fold.
